routes.association_basis: Reviewed methods of 10.1016/j.polymdegradstab.2023.110278. Bulk PDMS composite contains 9.5 nm CNTs or 6–10 nm-thick graphene nanoplatelets. Hydrothermal ageing is a later test, not a fabrication stage.

routes.route_name: Combinatorial co-sputtering and annealing of phase-change nanocomposite films
routes.source_page: Methods M2a Sample fabrication, PDFpage8; M2d HAADF-STEM and M2f Ge4Sb6Te7 photonic device fabrication, PDFpage9
routes.association_basis: Reviewed methods of 10.1038/s41467-020-19597-w. Reported 20 nm libraries and nanometre SbTe regions. CAMEO automates characterization selection, not synthesis; no autonomous sputtering claim.

routes.source_page: Experimental Methods > Synthesis of the ZnO@MFCNC Colloidal Nanohybrid (JATS sec3.2); Results and Discussion; Figure8
routes.association_basis: Reviewed methods of 10.1021/acsomega.8b01881. ZnO particles below approximately 20–25 nm on cellulose rods about 5 nm wide. Hop 2 via a directly cited 2024 review; upstream coating refers to another paper and is not independently validated here.

routes.route_name: Aerosol-assisted CVD of nanostructured doped-oxide films
routes.source_page: Experimental Section > Deposition Procedure (JATS sec4.1); Results and Discussion > Material Characterization (sec2.1), Figure2
routes.association_basis: Reviewed methods of 10.1021/acsomega.7b00759. Cu-doped ZnO films include 50–100 nm surface domes at the stated low-Cu composition; higher-Cu features extend above 100 nm. Hop 2 via the directly cited 2024 review.

routes.route_name: Mechanochemical nanocarbon coating and reactive spark-plasma sintering
routes.source_page: Sections2.1 Powder mixing and2.2 Spark plasma sintering process, manuscriptp3 / PDFp10; Section3.1 Ti64 and graphite composite powder, manuscriptp5 / PDFp12, Figure2
routes.association_basis: Reviewed methods of 10.1016/j.wear.2019.202944. Accepted-manuscript methods inspected. Nanoscale relevance is precursor carbon coating; final TiC is submicron. Hop 2 via the directly cited 2024 review.

routes.route_name: Electron-beam lithography, gold evaporation and lift-off
routes.source_page: Materials and Methods > Preparation, PDF page7; Results/Figure2 for40nm nanostructure height
routes.association_basis: Reviewed methods of 10.1038/s41377-018-0060-7. Reported gold nanostructures are 40 nm thick. Electron-beam evaporation is distinct from sputtering and pulsed-laser deposition.
